NgraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: The squash kept the tree and dropped the side history from every public ref. The pre-pin controls need the old source bytes. The C6 guard needs a witness that the archive is still the boundary archive and that the historical range is the twelve recorded paths. Git ancestry of HEAD cannot provide either witness. A raw src tree under scripts/ would. scripts/test-metrics.ts lists every .test.ts under src/ and scripts/, and that commit's src tree contains 51 such files, so validate:ci would run the historical suite and regenerate test-metrics.json. The repository therefore stores a tar plus a manifest, and the tests extract into a throwaway root. The src tree id, the twelve paths, and the six archive sha256 pairs are written in the spec so a clean clone can check the witness without the lost commits. The authority selected the content-addressed route on 2026-09-26. This file records the later correction of the fixture form and of the behavior-evidence route. It is not ratification.

Alternatives.Alternative: Store the pre-pin src tree as ordinary files under scripts/fixtures. The discovery walk treats those .test.ts files as the current suite. typecheck and a lint with assertions none stayed green on a disposable copy, and those greens did not see the stale metrics artifact. Rejected.

Reattach the side history. A bundle or a dangling object makes the commits exist and still leaves them off HEAD. This clone already has the objects, and the in-repository C6 test fails on ancestry. Rejected.

Leave the omitted-boundary call free of git, and also have that same call run git diff when the objects exist. Those two sentences cannot both be true. The git diff lives in a separate helper. The failing git runner on the omitted-boundary call stays meaningful only if that call spawns no git process of its own.

Treat a bun test exit 0 as proof of the pre-pin behavior. On a filesystem that does not recycle inodes those two tests skip and bun test still exits 0. Rejected. Scanning the whole JUnit document for a skipped element is also rejected: Bun's reporter writes a skipped element for every name-filtered test, so that scan is red when the two targets passed. The verifier reads only the two target testcase elements of the Ubuntu artifact.

Record the behavior pass by running ngrace gate verdict on a local Linux machine. Measured 2026-09-26: the running Podman machine's tmpfs /tmp and xfs /var/tmp do not recycle device/inode pairs, and an Alpine container on that machine does not either. The two controls would skip there. Rejected.

Have the Validate workflow run ngrace gate verdict and push run-ledger.xml. The workflow does not record verdicts. main requires the status checks validate, windows-compatibility, and dart-adapter, with enforce_admins enabled, so that job cannot push the ledger onto main. Rejected. The verdict stays a local ngrace gate verdict over the downloaded artifact.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The dormant scope-guard base 73044f83c3f4eaaaa5c5b7648a8a31c115337c39 is not an ancestor of HEAD either. The guard collects no evidence unless its switch names C-SUPERSEDE-INTEGRATION-CLOSE-1-82073AAC, and an unavailable git read refuses rather than reporting clean. It was not one of the three CI failures. The spec leaves it unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: A clean clone on Linux, with inode recycling, and without the three commits: extraction rebuilds tree b34bbc1fab64c6823afbf47311c39944ab2d74fe; the Validate job's exact-head checkout runs the pre-pin controls and the artifact's two target testcases contain no skipped, failure, or error child; filtered testcases may be skipped; the post-archive verifier exits 0 for that commit; the omitted-boundary C6 call is green and spawns no git; artifactIsStale against test-metrics.json is false.

This clone, where the objects exist and are not ancestors of HEAD: the omitted-boundary call is green and does not report the ancestry failure; the separate helper's git diff equals the twelve paths; the verifier exits non-zero until a successful exact-head artifact exists, and a report whose two target testcases are skipped is a refusal. Validate run 36218229773 on ubuntu-latest recorded those two controls as fail, not skip. The windows-compatibility job in that run printed the skip line.

A planted .test.ts under the fixture directory makes artifactIsStale true. Deleting it makes artifactIsStale false. A planted archive byte makes the omitted-boundary call fail closed. Restoring it greens the call. An explicit throwaway boundary that is off that throwaway's HEAD still fails closed.
